import json, re, random, sys, time, os
import chess

RULES = [(re.compile(p), r) for p, r in json.load(open(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "re.json")))]


def run(fen):
    for p, r in RULES:
        fen = p.sub(r, fen)
    return fen.split("\n")


def expected(board):
    out = set()
    for m in board.legal_moves:
        if m.promotion and m.promotion != chess.QUEEN:
            continue
        b = board.copy()
        b.push(m)
        out.add(" ".join(b.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    return out


def check(fen):
    ours = [" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in run(fen)]
    exp = expected(chess.Board(fen))
    ok = len(ours) == len(exp) and all(x in exp or x.rpartition(" ")[0] + " -" in exp for x in ours)
    if not ok:
        print("FAIL", fen)
        print(" extra:", [x for x in ours if not (x in exp or x.rpartition(" ")[0] + " -" in exp)])
        print(" missing:", exp - set(ours))
    return ok


ex = "<REDACTED_B64> w kq - 0 1"
print("\n".join(run(ex)))
check(ex)
random.seed(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 0)
n = fails = 0
t = time.time()
for g in range(300):
    b = chess.Board()
    while not b.is_game_over() and b.ply() < 200:
        if b.turn == chess.WHITE and any(True for _ in b.legal_moves):
            n += 1
            if not check(b.fen()):
                fails += 1
                if fails > 5:
                    sys.exit(1)
        moves = list(b.legal_moves)
        # bias toward captures/castling/pawn moves for coverage
        pri = [m for m in moves if b.is_castling(m) or b.is_en_passant(m) or m.promotion]
        b.push(random.choice(pri) if pri and random.random() < 0.7 else random.choice(moves))
print("positions", n, "fails", fails, "time/pos", (time.time() - t) / max(n, 1))
